verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha … and asked him,

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, ‘duppañño eḷamūgo’ti vuccatī”ti?
verses.english: How is a witless idiot defined?”

verses.pali: “Sattannaṁ kho, bhikkhu, bojjhaṅgānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā ‘duppañño eḷamūgo’ti vuccati.
verses.english: “Mendicant, they’re called a witless idiot because they haven’t developed and cultivated the seven awakening factors.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: imesaṁ kho, bhikkhu, sattannaṁ bojjhaṅgānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā ‘duppañño eḷamūgo’ti vuccatī”ti.
verses.english: They’re called a witless idiot because they haven’t developed and cultivated these seven awakening factors.”
